candidate.executed_scope: Native component variants only, not full custom decoder or Demuxe browser provider

acceptance.contract: Complete the bounded feasibility screen and preserve observed positives/negatives/blocks; status passed means screen completed, not all candidates passed.
acceptance.baseline: Per-experiment baseline recorded in RESEARCH.md and raw results
acceptance.oracle: Full-source frame outputs at matching timestamps, full JPEG decode/resize, same progressive JPEG final decode, independent NumPy transform oracle
acceptance.adverse_control: Unsupported option probes, output-count checks, filter pixel differences, DC-only algebraic counterexample

correctness_gate.note: Full provider gate is pending; individual component checks are documented.

performance.metric: Exploratory component wall/CPU time; image fidelity and payload accounting separately
performance.units: ms, bytes, SSIM, PSNR, exact hashes
performance.sampling: Variant-specific warmups/randomized trials; JPEG initial scaled test sequential order, disclosed. No retroactive performance threshold.
excluded_costs: full decoder integration for selective kernel
performance.uncertainty: Small synthetic corpus, one host, component-only scope, compiler/order effects. Quantified medians are not browser latency guarantees.

decision.reason: Pursue independent tiered preview delivery; keep custom video reconstruction optional, gated and removable. Individual path decisions and browser block are recorded separately.
decision.scope: Native synthetic component screen, not integrated browser preview qualification.

limits: No complete custom video decoder built
